### New Integrations


- Added new integrations:[Lytx One](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/lytx-one) ,[Rand McNally ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/rand-mcnally-eld) ,[Enterprise ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/enterprise-eld) ,[Luna ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/luna-eld) ,[MDM ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/mdm-eld) ,[One System ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/one-system-eld) ,[Delta Solutions ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/delta-solutions-eld) , and[Inspire ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/inspire-eld)


### Common Model Updates


- [HOS Available Time](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/hos-available-time) now includes current status start timestamps across supported providers


### Integration Updates


- [Geotab](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/geotab) now supports GPS harsh-driving exception rules for[Safety Events](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/safety-event)


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now includes Geotab safety-event enrichment controls in provider configuration settings
